So I've taken the Mon 10:00-10:30 entry back out of the calendar for now (it's still free on your side). As soon as he confirms the slot I'll book it and log it under `BOOKED:`. The alternates (Mon 14:00-14:30, Tue 11:00-11:30, Tue 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30, Wed 13:00-13:30) also stay clear until then.
OK, understood on Monday. One flag on the alternates: Tuesday 11:00-11:30 doesn't work for me — I have reading group 11:00-11:50. The other four look clear on my side.

All five TAs have replied — and there is **no window that suits everyone**. Here's the full picture:

| Mon 10:00-10:30 | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ Advisor 1:1 | ✅ | ✅ |

| Wed 13:00-13:30 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ reading group |

So the best we can do is 4 of 5: **Mon 10:00-10:30** misses only Priya (and it's your slight preference), while **Wed 13:00-13:30** (or Tue 11:00) misses only Hana.

How would you like to proceed? I can (a) book Mon 10:00 and ask Priya to try to move her advisor 1:1, (b) book Wed 13:00 and ask Hana the same about her reading group, or (c) book the slot you pick and simply tell the one who can't come. I can't move the TAs' other commitments myself.
Let's go with (a): book Mon 10:00-10:30 and ask Priya whether her advisor 1:1 can move that week. If she can't, we'll keep the slot and I'll catch her up separately.

You're right, and thanks — I missed it: Tuesday has Reading group 11:00-11:50, so Tue 11:00-11:30 is **not** free for you. I'll tell alvarez-agent to strike it. I checked the other four against the calendar and confirm they're clear: Mon 14:00-14:30, Tue 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30, Wed 13:00-13:30.
Perfect — those four are all good for me. Thanks.
👍 I'll book whichever slot alvarez-agent confirms, and log it under `BOOKED:` — nothing else needed from you for now.

Booked: **Mon 10:00-10:30 — CSE455 staff meeting** is now in /home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md, with `BOOKED: Monday 10:00-10:30 with CSE455 staff` in the log. All TAs have been told; Sarah, John, Diego and Hana are booking it, and Priya has been asked to try to move her advisor 1:1. I'll tell you what she says.
Great, thank you. Do let me know what Priya says.

Booked the CSE455 staff meeting with Alvarez for **Monday 10:00-10:30** (the professor's choice — it suits four of the five TAs). I dropped my provisional Mon 14:00-14:30 hold and logged the change.

One conflict: your **Advisor 1:1, Mon 09:00-10:20**, overlaps that staff meeting by 20 minutes. Alvarez asked whether your 1:1 can move that week — I have no direct channel to your advisor, so I need you for that.

Can the 1:1 move that Monday? If yes, tell me the new time (or let me know you'll arrange it) and I'll update the calendar. If not, no problem — the 10:00-10:30 meeting stands and Alvarez will fill you in separately.

Booked and logged: **Monday 10:00-10:30 — CSE455 staff meeting with Prof. Alvarez** (`BOOKED: Monday 10:00-10:30 with Professor Alvarez (CSE455 staff meeting)`). alvarez-agent says the professor has decided on that slot and he'll confirm once Priya's side is settled.

Keep the staff meeting at Mon 10:00-10:30 — I won't move it. I can't promise a new slot for the 1:1 on my own: I'll ask my advisor and tell you as soon as I know, so leave the 1:1 where it is for now.
Good — Monday 10:00-10:30 works for me, it fits right between office hours and quiz section. Let me know if Priya's side changes anything.
Will do — I'll let you know the moment alvarez-agent gets back to me either way.

Hi — Priya here (CSE455 TA). A CSE455 staff meeting with Prof. Alvarez has been set for Monday 10:00-10:30, which overlaps my Advisor 1:1 (Mon 09:00-10:20). Could you check whether that 1:1 can move that Monday, or pass the question on to my advisor? I'd rather keep the staff meeting as it stands.

I've logged the overlap and the fact that you're asking your advisor about a new slot for the 1:1 — tell me when you know and I'll move it and update the calendar. Anything else you'd like me to handle in the meantime?

Update on Priya: she confirms **Mon 10:00-10:30** stands and she's keeping the meeting. Her advisor 1:1 (09:00-10:20) can't be moved by her — she's asked her advisor and will report back; if it can't move, you catch her up separately as agreed. Nothing else outstanding: the other four TAs have all booked the slot.
That's all for now — I'll come back to you once I hear from my advisor about the 1:1.

Hi Priya. Two things:

- Your Advisor 1:1 isn't on the department schedule, so I have no access to it and can't move it or check whether it can move — please ask your advisor directly.
- For reference, the official schedule for Monday doesn't list a CSE455 staff meeting at 10:00-10:30. On Monday 09:00-10:00 there is CSE455 office hours, Curriculum committee and Seminar; CSE444 lecture runs 10:30-11:20. If the staff meeting is a new item, it hasn't reached me.

I don't arrange other people's meetings, so I can't pass the request on either.
Understood — thanks for chasing it. I'll catch Priya up separately if the 1:1 stays put.
Sounds good — I'll be here whenever you hear back. 👋
Understood — thanks. I'll ask my advisor directly about the 1:1.
Sounds good — good luck with the 1:1.
